title: Day 3: an AI made neck stretches into a game #shorts
description:
A neck stretch that plays like a game.

Neck Balloon is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Stand your iPhone on your desk. Slowly tilt, nod and turn your head to float a balloon into cloud rings, and hold it there. Rushing stirs up the wind and costs points, so you naturally stretch slow and wide. One minute a day.

Neck Balloon - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 4 tomorrow.

#neckstretch #deskstretch #posture #wellness #indiegame
